notes: Policy 1 is the only one verified at zero development losses (0.998 cost ratio). Policies 2 and 3 are untested edits that remove or tighten the clauses where losses appeared. They must be confirmed by compilation, live qualification and full serving-cost measurement before selection. votes743 and votes310/527 have little or no safe stop mass and mostly continue natively. Cost figures are surrogates, not live timing, and grouped folds are not independent holdouts.

policies.name: conservative_a
policies.rationale: Verified zero development losses; conservative cp64 stops on unfiltered and votes32.

policies.name: moderate_b_fixed
policies.rationale: Policy B with the lossy unfiltered cp64 clause replaced by the verified-clean tighter A clause (tenth_distance<=0.36 excludes both observed lossy cases).

policies.name: broad_c_fixed
policies.rationale: Policy C with the lossy unfiltered cp64 clause removed. Other filters showed no losses in the evaluated batch, but this exact combination is unevaluated.
